name: SAI weekly question template
rules: Short simple English for Class 6-10. Correct natural Malayalam. One clear answer. Hints guide, never give away. Explanations in 1 line.

batches.plan: Call 1-2: Reasoning + Observation L1-L2. Call 3-4: Logic + Coding L1-L2. Call 5: Problem Solving L1-L3. Call 6 (spare): refill weakest skill.

sample.prompt_en: Odd one out: Apple, Banana, Carrot, Mango. Which is different?
sample.prompt_ml: വ്യത്യസ്തമായത് കണ്ടെത്തൂ: ആപ്പിൾ, വാഴപ്പഴം, കാരറ്റ്, മാമ്പഴം.
sample.explanation_en: Carrot is a vegetable. Others are fruits.
